signature: a rounded slate cube with round brass glasses over big eyes and one leaf

parts.name: feet
parts.motion: staggered in profile; a row longer in hop 2, tucked in hop 3 and react, hidden in nap and on the perch

parts.name: glasses
parts.motion: pushed up onto the top plane in nap, rims flash in special

parts.name: head-top growth
parts.motion: leans back in E/W, up in hop 2/3, react, cheer, special; swept back in cling; droops in nap

parts.name: near arm
parts.motion: hidden at idle; out in hop 3/4, up in react and cheer, gripping in cling, forward in special

parts.name: far arm
parts.motion: hidden at idle; out in hop 3/4, up in react and cheer, gripping in cling

parts.name: lamp facet
parts.motion: lamp glow on the top plane; special only

notes: Growth stages: 1 one leaf, 2 a second smaller leaf, 3 a closed bud at the stem top.
Perch: a 16 px redraw (one lens, the far rim, a one-pixel stem) facing the foe.
